# Yahoo! News Japan

> Japan's leading news aggregation platform delivering breaking news, live coverage, expert analysis, and user-generated content across politics, economics, entertainment, and social issues.

Yahoo! News Japan (news.yahoo.co.jp) is a comprehensive news portal that aggregates content from major Japanese media outlets including TBS NEWS DIG, FNN Prime Online, and Sankei Shimbun. The platform offers real-time breaking news, 24-hour live feeds, expert columns, original reporting, and interactive features like public opinion polls to keep Japanese audiences informed on domestic and international events.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Live News Coverage
- Japan-US Summit
- Middle East Tensions
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- Politics & Government
- Economics & Markets
- Entertainment News
- Social Issues
- Trending Topics
- Expert Analysis
- Public Opinion Polls
- Regional News
- Current Events
- News Rankings

## Core News Feeds

- [Yahoo! News Portal](https://news.yahoo.co.jp): Main news portal aggregating news, videos, magazines and user-written articles.
- [Breaking News](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/flash): Breaking news across all genres from news agencies and media outlets.
- [Live News Feed](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/live): Live news feed from TV stations and media outlets with 24-hour coverage.
- [Main Topics](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/topics/top-picks): Main topics and headlines delivered in chronological order on Yahoo! News.

## Featured Content & Analysis

- [Expert Columns](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/expert): Expert columns and opinion pieces on politics, economics, sports and lifestyle.
- [Original Content](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/original): Yahoo! News original content and partner collaborations on current events.
- [Premium News Articles](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/paidnews): Premium paid news articles on economics, politics, entertainment and sports.

## International & Political News

- [Japan-US Summit Concludes Successfully](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/pickup/6573741): Japan-US summit between PM Takahashi and Trump on Middle East stability.
- [Kuwait Oil Refinery Drone Attack](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/pickup/6573742): Drone attack on Kuwait oil refinery amid Iran-Israel Middle East tensions.
- [PM Takaichi's Summit Dinner Speech](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/pickup/6573725): PM Takaichi's humorous speech at Japan-US summit diplomatic dinner.

## Economics & Markets

- [Hong Kong Gasoline Prices Hit Record High](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/pickup/6573749): Hong Kong gasoline prices surge to historic high amid Middle East tensions.
- [Crude Oil Impact on Holiday Travel](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/pickup/6573743): Crude oil prices impact leisure travel during Japan's holiday periods.
- [Third Wage Increase Initiatives](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/pickup/6573746): Japanese companies implementing third wage increase as employee benefits.

## Social Issues & Society

## Community & Engagement

- [Public Opinion Polls](https://news.yahoo.co.jp/polls): Public opinion polls on trending news topics with voting and trend analysis.
